description: Source code for a BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter) module in C, providing functions to load, manipulate, and interact with eBPF maps and programs, including error handling, resource management, and integration with a scripting environment.

classes.name: uc_bpf_fd
classes.description: Resource structure representing a BPF file descriptor with close flag.

classes.name: uc_bpf_map
classes.description: Resource structure representing a BPF map with associated file descriptor and key/value sizes.

classes.name: uc_bpf_map_iter
classes.description: Iterator structure for traversing BPF map keys.

methods.name: set_error
methods.description: Sets the last error message and code, with formatted message support.

methods.name: init_env
methods.description: Initializes environment limits for BPF operations.

methods.name: uc_bpf_error
methods.description: Returns the last error message or code in the scripting environment.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_set_opts
methods.description: Configures BPF module options such as rodata and program types.

methods.name: uc_bpf_open_module
methods.description: Loads a BPF module from a file path with optional configuration.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_create
methods.description: Creates a resource object for a BPF map.

methods.name: uc_bpf_prog_create
methods.description: Creates a resource object for a BPF program.

methods.name: uc_bpf_open_map
methods.description: Opens an existing BPF map by file descriptor.

methods.name: uc_bpf_open_program
methods.description: Opens an existing BPF program by file descriptor.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_maps
methods.description: Retrieves list of map names in a BPF module.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_map
methods.description: Retrieves a specific map resource by name.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_programs
methods.description: Retrieves list of program names in a BPF module.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_program
methods.description: Retrieves a specific program resource by name.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_get
methods.description: Gets a value from a BPF map by key.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_set
methods.description: Sets a value in a BPF map by key.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_delete
methods.description: Deletes a key-value pair from a BPF map.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_delete_all
methods.description: Deletes all entries in a BPF map, optionally filtered by a callable.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_iterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator for traversing BPF map keys.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_iter_next
methods.description: Gets the next key from a BPF map iterator.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_iter_next_int
methods.description: Gets the next key as an integer from a BPF map iterator.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all map entries, calling a function for each.

methods.name: uc_bpf_obj_pin
methods.description: Pins a BPF object (map or program) to a filesystem path.

methods.name: uc_bpf_program_pin
methods.description: Pins a BPF program.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_pin
methods.description: Pins a BPF map.

methods.name: uc_bpf_set_tc_hook
methods.description: Sets a traffic control hook for a network interface.

methods.name: uc_bpf_program_tc_attach
methods.description: Attaches a BPF program to a traffic control hook.

methods.name: uc_bpf_tc_detach
methods.description: Detaches a BPF program from a traffic control hook.

methods.name: uc_bpf_debug_print
methods.description: Custom print function for libbpf debug output, forwarding to scripting environment.

methods.name: uc_bpf_set_debug_handler
methods.description: Sets a custom debug handler for libbpf output.

methods.name: register_constants
methods.description: Registers BPF-related constants in the scripting environment.

methods.name: uc_module_init
methods.description: Initializes the BPF module, registering functions, constants, and types.
